subject: Pricing follow-up: expansion volumes, blended rates & route add
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@apertureanalytics.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@apertureanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call summary & ask — expansion volumes, target $/1M, route add

Hi Jordan + Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — good to get aligned on Aperture's usage patterns and the upcoming renewal window. Quick recap + asks so we can put a concrete expansion pricing proposal on paper: 

Recap from our call:
- Current production traffic: ~120M tokens/month across two generative routes (infer-standard, embed-compact).
- Planned expansion: pilot adding a high-throughput model (fast-gen) for low-latency inference and a new reranking route for search relevance.
- Timing: intent to increase to ~600M tokens/month over next 6 months if SLA + unit econ align with budget.

Asks we discussed:
1) Can you confirm the budget range you have for incremental capacity (monthly or committed)? You mentioned a target around $5k–$9k/month for the pilot and ~$60k/month at steady state — please confirm whether those are firm. We use a $/1M token unit to frame options, so helpful to have a target $/1M token range.
2) Which workloads should be considered latency-critical (we'll price a lower-latency route higher)? My note: search rerank + UX chat = latency-critical; bulk embeddings = cost-sensitive.
3) Any constraints on contract term or prepayment (monthly vs 12-month commit)?

What we'll do next (our side):
- Attach: current pricing deck + your usage snapshot from the call.
- Internal: build 2 concrete pricing scenarios: a) 6-month pilot (soft commitment, higher unit rate) and b) 12-month stepped commit that tiers down to blended $/1M at scale. We will include per-route pricing for infer-standard, fast-gen, and embed-compact.

Could you reply with the budget confirmation and which volume bands are highest priority to secure first? If it's easier, I can propose a short follow-up where we run through numbers together.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0163

Attachments: redwood-pricing-deck-v3.pdf (PDF), aperture-usage-snapshot-dec2026.csv (CSV)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@apertureanalytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call summary & ask — expansion volumes, target $/1M, route add

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the succinct recap — that matches how we heard it. A few clarifications: 

1) Budget: the $5k–$9k/month is for the initial pilot (2–3 months). For the longer-term target (after pilot) our finance sponsor is budgeting ~$50k–$70k/month to support the 500–700M token run rate. So $/1M target we had in mind is roughly $80–$140 per 1M tokens at pilot cadence, trending toward $35–$60 per 1M at full scale depending on SLA.

2) Priority workloads:
- Rerank/search (latency-sensitive) — priority #1 for low tail latency.
- UX chat (sessioned context) — priority #2.
- Bulk embedding pipelines (nightly) — cost-sensitive, can tolerate higher latency.

3) Contract term: open to a 12-month step-up if we can get predictable blended economics and a commitment credit structure. Prepayment is unlikely; prefer monthly invoicing with a usage commitment and exit provisions.

Jordan
Director of Product, Aperture Analytics
jordan.ellis@apertureanalytics.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pricing follow-up — Aperture — pilot & blended ask (need calc)

Ben/Marissa — forwarding the reply from Aperture (below). They confirmed pilot budget and a target steady state monthly budget. Action items: 

1) Can you run two blended pricing scenarios for APTR-2026-047:
   a) Pilot (3 months): 120M -> 200M tokens/month, target unit $80–$140 per 1M. Include per-route (infer-standard, fast-gen, embed-compact) pricing and expected token mix.
   b) Commit (12 months): step-up bands from 200M -> 600M tokens/month over 6 months, target blended $35–$60 per 1M at scale. Include a step-up credit table and suggested SLA for low-latency route.

2) Include options for:
   - Can we offer the fast-gen route at a 10–15% premium to infer-standard for the first 3 months to support pilot adoption?
   - Suggested canary strategy for rolling fast-gen into production (capacity/burst plan).

3) Attach the price calc and short note for the legal/finance team (we'll need a one-page term summary for monthly vs commit).

Timing: they want concrete numbers early next week. Can you prioritize? Mark it urgent on the deal.

Thanks —
Mina

Attachments: Aperture reply (in thread).

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@apertureanalytics.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@apertureanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call summary & ask — expansion volumes, target $/1M, route add

Jordan / Priya — thanks for the confirmation and the budget ranges. Quick note on next steps and timing: 

- We're assembling the two scenarios and will send a compact price comparison (pilot vs 12-month step-up) including per-route breakouts by end of day Monday.
- Would you be available for a 30-minute walkthrough Tuesday morning (Dec 21) to review assumptions and pick the option to take to Finance? Proposed time: 9:30am PT. If that doesn't work tell me a couple alternatives.
- I'll include the recommendation to price fast-gen at a 12% premium for the pilot (we'll propose a 6% credit if they convert to the 12-month commit within 90 days).

If you want us to show a blended $/1M that assumes an 18% embed share vs 62% infer-standard vs 20% fast-gen, say so — otherwise I'll use the session mix from your usage snapshot.

Best —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0163
